artifact_verification.verification_scope: Downloaded official archive, receipt provenance and payload integrity only; no local project build, formatter, lint, syntax check or test.

flat_profile.package_sources: Hosted Ubuntu noble-updates/main and noble-security/main apt repositories; package policy and ownership logs retained.

explicit_symbol_name_groups.scope: Lower bound for directly named sqlite3 symbols; internal parser and optimizer aliases are not all included.

limitations: Flat on-CPU user-space samples cover the complete original target lifetime, including fixture setup, management enrollment and logins, control negotiation, application flow opening and failure teardown. No call graph or per-phase sample report was recorded.

The 244.9-second wall-clock fixture setup is not a CPU attribution. Flat crypto, JSON and SQLite samples cannot be assigned to setup, opening, currentness, signing versus verification or any particular SQL operation.
Sample percentages are sampled on-CPU overhead, not wall-clock waiting, database admission queue time, Store mutex wait duration, SQL timing or elapsed open_stream duration.

Explicit symbol groups are descriptive matches, not an exhaustive disjoint cost model; some groups overlap other subsystem names. An absence of a high-level NestLink symbol is not absence of inlined work.
800 readiness records do not establish all 1000 targets alive together, survival through the original two-second hold, completed accounting or three successful waves.

This diagnostic uses the unchanged original offered load and deadlines but additional release debug symbols. It qualifies neither AC68 nor an unsampled capacity pass and does not replace any earlier failure.
One hosted process does not qualify 100 independently deployed physical nodes, external relay capacity, all queue bounds or cross-day soak.
No production permission, SQL, signature or currentness behavior was changed for this diagnostic. Existing bounded prepared statement reuse is already present in the tested source.

receipt.scope: Original HTTP management and signed grants, actual kernel QUIC/TCP targets, original limits and four-scope durable accounting. One independent management login per active consumer, unchanged original rate limits.
limitations: one hosted process; not physical nodes or independently deployed relay runtimes
short-run samples cannot qualify cross-day soak, complete E2E or all bounded queues
